title: Build clean-trunk and managed delivery repositories from explicit MakeMe data

## Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-262#migrate-clean-trunk-fixtures

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision:** SEED-262#migrate-clean-trunk-fixtures (`.planning/seeds/SEED-262-faster-dashboard-test-feedback.md#migrate-clean-trunk-fixtures`, plan `.planning/slice-plans/514-migrate-clean-trunk-fixtures/PLAN.md`) at 73bc7bbce5fbdd137057aaed05f81fcc59478aa1.
- **Promise:** Scope, first item: "The materializer adds the worktree beside the integration checkout and commits the revisions without pushing." Expected observable behavior: the bare origin holds only the trunk branch; the workspace branch and its candidate commit stay local.
- **Fault:** in `tests/support/repository-fixture.mjs`, `buildTemplate`, one line added after the workspace revision loop (after `commits.set(revision.name, candidateSha);`): `await git(execution, "push", "--quiet", "origin", workspace.branch);`. The materializer then also pushed `exec/story` to origin. No fixture or assertion was changed.
- **Fixture:** `makeMe.aRepository.withTrunkBranch("trunk").withRevision("start", …).withWorkspace("exec/story", { from: "start" }).withUnpublishedRevision("increment", …).please()`, materialized through `materializeRepository`.
- **Maintained assertion:** `tests/support/repository-fixture.test.mjs` "a workspace suffix is committed on its branch beside an origin that holds only the trunk", line 67: `assert.equal(await read(origin, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)"), "refs/heads/trunk")`. The later `assert.rejects(git(origin, "cat-file", "-e", candidateSha))` (line 83) guards the same promise but was not reached.
- **Run observations:**
  - Scratch: detached worktree of 73bc7bbce at `/Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/c14a6183/tmp/intent-scratch`, `npm ci` there, empty `git status --porcelain` before the probe.
  - Baseline: the focused command (`PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR bash scripts/test.sh tests/support/repository-fixture.test.mjs`) exited 0 with no output. A spec-reporter run (`node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-name-pattern=…`) showed the selected test ran and passed (1 test, 1 pass).
  - Fault: same command exited 1. Exactly one failure, the selected test, at line 67. Actual `'refs/heads/exec/story\nrefs/heads/trunk'`, expected `'refs/heads/trunk'`. The actual value is independent evidence that origin gained the workspace branch, so the fault changed the intended path and the intended assertion caught it.
  - Restoration: `git checkout -- tests/support/repository-fixture.mjs` ran through an EXIT/INT/TERM trap. Afterwards `git diff` was empty and `git status --porcelain` matched the pre-probe state. The same command then exited 0 with no output.
  - Cleanup: removed the scratch worktree with `git worktree remove --force`. `--force` was needed only because of the untracked `node_modules` from `npm ci`. I did not edit the execution checkout. It now shows modified `.planning/PRODUCT-BACKLOG.md` and `tests/README.md`, which were not written by this check.

### Cost

- **Test runtime:** measured. The runner's per-file job times (`OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES`) were 1.5 s for the baseline, 1.5 s with the fault and 1.6 s after restoration, about 4.6 s of wall-clock seconds in total. The spec-reporter confirmation run reported 457 ms (`duration_ms`).
- **Human effort:** unavailable. This agent run had no human interaction to measure.
- **Agent effort:** unavailable. No separately supported measure (tokens or active agent time) was exposed to this run.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 52507 ms (measured), from 1794136311769 to 1794136364276 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
